_doc: Every slice constant (Docs/Specs/SLICE_DESIGN.md §8; GAME-010 retune: Docs/Design/TUNING_PS1.md). GDD = game tuning; SRC = tool-derived; tax/rounding live in Data/Catalog/pricing.json.
_jarMinVisibleStepPct: GAME-005 / DEC-046 [GDD]: a jar above 0 g shows at least this PROC-002 fill step. 20 because the 55 mm base band hides F010 from the front; set 10 once PROC-003 raises F010 above the band.
_adultUseLimitGrams: DEC-036 M1: A.R.S. 36-2858(A)(1)(c), 1 oz adult-use flower per transaction
_storeHours: DEC-036 M3: real store hours 08:00-22:00 (RES-001); the shift clock starts at shiftStartHour [GDD]
_twoItemAskChance: GAME-006 [GDD, start 0.25]: chance a customer adds a second item ('…and an eighth of something for energy'); real-store units/sale ≈ 2 (RES-001 O13)
_cartMaxLines: GAME-006 / UX_PS1 §2: the register holds 1-3 lines
_overLimitAskChance: GAME-007 / SPEC_COMP002 §2 [GDD]: chance a customer asks for more than the 1 oz cap (one of the three §2 ask shapes); retune in GAME-010
_meterAmberFraction: SPEC_COMP002 §2 / UX_PS1 §3 [GDD]: the limit meter turns amber at this fraction of the cap
_primaryTrimFitPenalty: SPEC_COMP002 §2 [GDD]: trimming the primary item (ask 1) costs this × its fit
_strikeReviewThreshold: SPEC_COMP002 §2 / UX_PS1 §6 [GDD]: strikes in one shift that flag 'Manager review'; strikes never end the shift (DEC-032)
_strikeToastSeconds: UX_PS1 §6: strike toasts stay 6 s (sale toasts toastSeconds)
_coverCheckIn: GAME-008 / SPEC_COMP002 §3 [GDD]: at rush start, coverCheckInChance offers 'cover the ID stand' for the next coverCheckInCount arrivals; the prompt auto-declines after coverPromptSeconds (UX_PS1 §4); declining adds declineCheckInDelaySec of wait to those arrivals
_idRules: [SRC] B1 minAgeYears 21; B2/O3 verticalGraceDays 30 (an Arizona vertical ID counts only within 30 days of turning 21)
_shiftDate: GAME-008 [GDD]: in-game date the ID panel shows; a Tuesday to match shiftDayOfWeek 2
_medical: GAME-009 / SPEC_COMP002 §4: medicalCustomerShare [GDD] 0.04 (DEC-048: medical is under 5 %); outOfStateMedChance [GDD] of MED customers; medicalLimitGrams14d [SRC] A5 2.5 oz x 28.35 (GAP-COMP-06); medicalTaxRate [SRC] F4 9.1 % TPT only (provisional, OPEN-4); seeded 14-day history = 0..medicalHistoryMaxBuys prior buys of a weightOdds weight [GDD]
